title: Barfresh Re-Engages with Nation's Fourth-Largest School District, Fueled by New In-House Manufacturing Capacity
summary: Carton Smoothies Added to the Menu as Expanded Arps Dairy Facility Comes Online Florida's Largest School District Adds New Product for the 2026-27 School...
body_markdown:
*Carton Smoothies Added to the Menu as Expanded Arps Dairy Facility Comes Online*


*Florida's Largest School District Adds New Product for the 2026-27 School Year*


LOS ANGELES, Aug. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Barfresh Food Group Inc. (the “Company” or “Barfresh”) (Nasdaq: BRFH), a provider of frozen, ready-to-blend and ready-to-drink beverages, today announced it has expanded its product offering with the fourth largest school district in the United States, located in Florida, to include carton smoothies on the district’s school menu beginning with the 2026-27 school year.


Barfresh had previously served this Florida district, which enrolls more than 300,000 students. For a period, the Company’s ability to fully support the district’s volume was constrained by its reliance on third-party co-manufacturers, whose capacity and supply limitations narrowed the scope of the relationship. Barfresh has since brought a substantial share of its manufacturing in-house at its Arps Dairy facility in Ohio, and that added control over production and supply has allowed the Company to re-engage the district at a larger scale, now including carton smoothies.


The expanded relationship extends a recent run of momentum for the Company in the K-12 education channel. In July 2026, Barfresh announced the addition of 50 school districts across Ohio, representing a combined student population of more than 300,000.


“Expanding our work with this district to include carton smoothies reflects the strength of the relationship we’ve built with them over time, and it fits the broader momentum we’re seeing in the education channel following our recent expansion across Ohio,” said Riccardo Delle Coste, Chief Executive Officer of Barfresh. “Wins like this validate the sales execution and product portfolio we’ve built, and we expect that momentum to continue as we head into the new school year. Our ability to support wins of this size is underpinned by our expanding manufacturing footprint in Ohio, where our Arps Dairy processing facility now supports approximately 75% of our frozen beverage and food volume. Once complete, our larger, 44,000-square-foot facility in Defiance is expected to be operating at just 15% of capacity, leaving significant room for further expansion in the K-12 channel with both existing and new products, while also driving meaningful efficiencies. As that additional capacity comes online, we expect it to support even more opportunities.”


**About Barfresh Food Group**


Barfresh Food Group Inc. (Nasdaq: BRFH) is a developer, manufacturer and distributor of ready-to-blend and ready-to-drink beverages, including smoothies, shakes and frappes, primarily for the education market, foodservice industry and restaurant chains, delivered as fully prepared individual portions or single serving and bulk formats for on-site preparation.
